description: This file contains shell script functions implementing tests for diff algorithms, including setup of test cases, comparing file differences, and verifying diff outputs. It utilizes external tools like git for version control and testing frameworks for validation.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Sets up test cases comparing two C source files ('file1' and 'file2') generated within the function, executes various git diff commands with different diff algorithms, and verifies the outputs against expected results. It also tests attribute-based diff driver configuration and command-line precedence.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Creates two text files with different contents ('uniq1' and 'uniq2'), generates their hashes, and asserts that the diff output correctly identifies the files as completely different.
